rows.grounds: past passive participle of kath in nominative singular neuter

items.question: Why is this substance called amṛta?
premises: Tattva manifestation is caused by it.
items.inference: The substance receives the name amṛta because it causes tattva to manifest.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'it' depends on the preceding ritual-substance context.
items.plain_english: Because it causes the manifestation of tattva, it is called amṛta, dear one.
